[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean

def implementation (s : String) : String :=
let words := s.split (fun c => c = ' ');
let ordered_words := words.map (fun w => w.data.sort Nat.le);
" "++.toString ordered_words
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma string_split_map_split_eq
(s : String) :
  s.split (fun c => c = ' ').map (fun w => w.data) = s.map (fun c => c.val).split (fun c => c = ' ')
:=
by
  induction' s
  simp [String.split]
  unfold String.split
  simp [String.split]
  simp [String.split]
  simp [String.split]
  simp [String.split]

lemma string_map_concat_eq
(s : String) (f : Char → String) :
  s.map f = s.foldr (fun c r => f c ++ r) ""
:=
by
  induction' s
  simp [String.map, String.foldr]
  simp [String.map, String.foldr]

lemma string_split_map_sort_eq
(s : String) :
  (s.split (fun c => c = ' ').map (fun w => w.data.sort Nat.le)).toString = s.split (fun c => c = ' ').map (fun w => w.data) >>= (fun c => "[Char " ++ c.val.toString ++ " ]".toString) >>= (fun ws => " ".toString ++ ws.join " ".toString)
:=
by
  induction' s
  simp [String.split, String.map, String.sort, String.toString, String.join]
